card.name: After a person's name, before their title
card.fires_on: The comma or 'is' right after a person's name, just before a job title or affiliation is given (e.g. 'director of', 'a senior fellow with'). It also fires on a comma after a named thing that is about to be described.

modes.label: Comma after a name
modes.description: A comma follows a full person's name and introduces their role or description.
